_comment: PPA scan parameters - the ONLY control surface. Hermes edits this file, then restarts the scanner jobs. states: any of TX AZ OH OK FL LA WV IL GA NC NJ PA. workers: threads per node (60-150). daily_volume_target: compile target for the daily batch.
_comment_cycle: cycle_days: sent leads older than this become 'fresh' and reusable (priority=standard). NEW always wins.
_comment_cap: daily_rate_cap: system-wide throughput cap (unique phones per rolling 24h); governor SIGSTOPs lanes above cap, resumes at 85%
